name: tangent-blend
why: A blend whose ends land on faces the boss is exactly tangent to, where the fillet's width falls to zero. Stock OCCT hands back a self-intersecting corner patch with IsDone() == true; the vendored tangent-pinch patch builds the exact pinched torus instead, and this case holds the measured result down. Pairs with tangent-blend-retainer for the single-stripe form and with blend-runs-off-the-edge, which proves a genuine overrun was never the problem.
